title: Oops!... I Parsed It Again: Tool-Call Smuggling Against LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.30624v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents act through tool calls: the model writes the arguments of a call as JSON, a guard decides whether the call may run, and an executor runs it. The same bytes are parsed several times, by the provider, gateways, SDKs, frameworks, the guard, and the executor. JSON leaves some choices to each parser, such as which copy of a repeated key counts. When the guard and the executor choose differently, the guard approves one call, the executor runs another, and the audit log records the approved one. We introduce this attack, tool-call smuggling, and study it across the stack. We describe six ways in which the same bytes yield different calls and build a differential testing harness that gives identical bytes to 17 pinned parser and validator configurations; most pairs disagree on some inputs, and even two official MCP SDKs accept different inputs. translated_title: 哎呀！……我又解析了一遍：针对大语言模型智能体的工具调用走私攻击
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体通过工具调用来执行操作：模型将调用的参数写成 JSON 格式，守卫决定该调用是否可以运行，执行器负责运行它。同样的字节会被多个组件反复解析，包括提供商、网关、SDK、框架、守卫和执行器。JSON 把一些解释权留给了各个解析器，例如重复键中哪一份副本才生效。当守卫和执行器做出不同选择时，守卫批准的是一个调用，执行器实际运行的却是另一个调用，而审计日志记录的只是被批准的那一个。我们提出了这种攻击，即“工具调用走私”，并在整个技术栈中对它进行了研究。我们描述了六种相同字节产生不同调用的方式，并构建了一个差分测试工具，向 17 个固定版本的解析器和验证器配置提供完全相同的字节；大多数配置组合在某些输入上会出现分歧，甚至两个官方 MCP SDK 接受的输入也不相同。在 τ-bench 和 AgentDojo 的任务上，能够在传输过程中重写字节的攻击者……
tldr: 论文提出“工具调用走私”攻击：利用 JSON 在守卫、执行器等多个解析器之间语义不一致的漏洞，使守卫批准的工具调用与执行器实际运行的调用不同，从而绕过大语言模型智能体的安全防护并留下虚假审计记录。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "tool-call smuggling," an attack that exploits JSON parser inconsistencies across the LLM agent stack, so the security guard approves one tool call while the executor runs a different one, bypassing defenses and leaving misleading audit logs.
